{{Top|leg}}
The '''Magistrate Council''' was a three-person body that acted as a judiciary body in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. Local businesspeople and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] staffed the Council, including [[Mortris Gallorr]], his son [[Arno Gallorr]], and [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Moira Kruger]]. The Council was responsible for dealing with non-lethal disputes and ruling on the cases.<ref name="HNNA">{{JournalCite|12|Heroes Need Not Apply}}</ref>
